verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a Reviews API (POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve), an early-fraud-warnings API, an official MCP server, a CLI and LLM-readable docs, so an agent can reach review objects and act on them, with summarizing and recommending done on the agent side. The rich case context, such as risk insights and the related-payments network, is documented only as a Dashboard feature, and no evidence shows the MCP server exposes Radar reviews. missing for 10: documented API/MCP endpoint for listing and pulling flagged reviews with full context, risk-insight data exposed programmatically, MCP tool coverage of Radar reviews, any human-confirm workflow for agent recommendations, hands-on corroboration.
